topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: It’s a funny thing, pouring your heart into an idea, crafting it, nurturing it until it feels like a part of you. I was so sure this was my ticket, a way to contribute something meaningful. You can imagine my surprise when I found out someone else had already paved the road, already secured the patent. It’s a bit like running a race, only to trip just before the finish line. I keep thinking, if I had known, if I had only searched a little harder before I began. But then, I also remind myself, every end is a new beginning, a chance to learn and grow. I guess, for now, I just need to take a step back, breathe, and think about the next path.
